scopeClarification.reason: The phrase 'five PG-IAM endpoints' denotes the five approved PG-IAM target page identities (GROUP, REGION, PROJECT, HEAD_COMPANY and STORE), while the same frozen design requires removal of request pageDesignKey and all fallbacks across four controllers. Current source proves that the complete implementation denominator is eight operations; narrowing to five would retain three instances of the prohibited authority chain.
scopeClarification.nonExpansion: This is the complete existing pageKey authority/fallback surface required by the already-frozen P3-C instruction; it adds no Journey, endpoint family, permission model, migration, UI behavior or product decision.

actualChangeSurfaceCorrection.reason: The frozen manifest lists the access OpenAPI path and two owner libraries. P3-C necessarily also changes the authoritative generated route/consumer artifacts, edge adapters, capability resolver enforcement and focused tests that consume the same five approved endpoint contracts. This enumerates existing dependencies without adding a Journey, migration, UI interaction, or P3-D behavior.
